name: wardley-published-start-baseline-and-force-left-anchor-1fb7869-v1

excerpts.text:
**IMPORTANT**: Wardley Maps use the OnlineWardleyMaps (OWM) format: `[visibility, evolution]`

- **First value (Visibility)**: 0.0-1.0 (bottom to top) - Y-axis position
- **Second value (Evolution)**: 0.0-1.0 (left to right) - X-axis position

note "text" [visibility, evolution]
```

> **Note**: Text must be enclosed in quotes.

```mermaid-example
wardley-beta
title Notes

```mermaid-example
wardley-beta
title Forces

component Legacy [0.20, 0.85]
component Modern [0.55, 0.60]
component AI [0.70, 0.35]

Legacy -> Modern
Modern -> AI

accelerator "AI Adoption" [0.55, 0.25]
deaccelerator "Legacy Constraints" [0.15, 0.75]
```

positiveGate: Actual independent gray-axis plot frame; source-independent physical anchor measurements; each source-coordinate projected point within2px. Notes additionally require glyph IoU>=.97, alpha MAE<=.04 and plausible-origin spread<=.5px. No gate was changed after results.
limits: Positive-only decoder for this explicitly published encoding. Other encodings remain unknown. No default size, font or palette obligation is imposed; no actual SVG x/y or output agreement supplies truth. Legend520 clamp is excluded.
